description.value: AI agents that "collect, classify, extract and cross-check every document in a file" and post structured data to the customer's system.
Sells document AI software. Its AI agents collect, classify, extract, verify and analyze documents and send structured data to customers' systems.
A Singapore-based Document AI company, founded in 2019, that extracts structured data from unstructured documents.

product_description.value: AI agents that collect, classify, extract and cross-check documents. Business teams build workflows in plain English, and every extracted field carries a confidence score.
Document AI, Case Management, Document Workflows, a workflow agent, Data Table and Copilot, and a document extraction API.
OCR and machine learning tools that convert invoices, bank statements, tax returns and insurance forms into structured data, with 30+ readymade APIs and a human-in-the-loop review step.

business_model_description.value: Free plan for 14 days (up to 1,000 pages and 10 users). Business and Enterprise plans are custom-priced on processing volume, with up to 10% off annual subscriptions.
Free plan (14 days, up to 1,000 pages, 10 users). Business and Enterprise plans are custom-priced by processing volume, and annual subscriptions get up to 10% off.
API-first software and API offering sold to enterprises (inferred; pricing not stated).

PayU was its first enterprise client, onboarded in October 2019. Its site names insurance, banking, lending and logistics as target sectors.
